description: This script is a shell script used to run a Python code generator and compile a test application for verifying generated code, related to rbus code generation following a specific style.

methods.name: echo
methods.description: Outputs the value of specified environment variables and script arguments.

methods.name: python
methods.description: Invokes the specified Python script with given arguments to generate code.

methods.name: gcc
methods.description: Compiles the generated code and helper C files into an executable test application.
